verdict.rationale: Jev is a stateless typed-decision model API: you send state and Choice/Score/Noul questions and get structured answers, called from your own code via the SDKs. Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows belongs to an orchestration or automation platform, not a model-inference endpoint, so this story is a category error for this product. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships any scheduling or workflow capability that would make the axis apply.
